messages.subject: International Executive | Mining, ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Sarita,

Your leadership work across board, executive and expatriate hiring in Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and emerging markets makes this a focused introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading across government/regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate/external affairs, strategic partnerships and executive stakeholder engagement.

I am open to Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates internationally, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE as priority markets.

My executive CV is attached for consideration for suitable current or future assignments.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
